facts.text: Anantara Kihavah is a private island in the Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.
facts.excerpt: Set within the Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, Anantara Kihavah is an island

facts.text: The resort is minutes away from Hanifaru Bay, home to the world's largest gatherings of manta rays.
facts.excerpt: it is just minutes away from Hanifaru Bay, home to the world’s largest gatherings of manta rays

facts.text: Manta ray season at Hanifaru Bay runs from May to November.
facts.excerpt: Hanifaru Bay during the months of May to November which is considered as manta ray season

facts.text: A house reef surrounds the island.
facts.excerpt: our vibrant house reef surrounds the island with extraordinary marine life and endless turquoise horizons

facts.text: SKY is the Maldives' first overwater observatory.
facts.excerpt: SKY, the Maldives’ first overwater observatory

facts.text: Guests can stargaze at SKY through the Indian Ocean's most powerful telescope.
facts.excerpt: stargaze through the Indian Ocean’s most powerful telescope

facts.text: SEA is the Maldives' only underwater caviar restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Dine beneath the ocean at SEA, the Maldives’ only underwater caviar restaurant

facts.text: At SEA, daytime brings turtles, butterflyfish, unicorn fish and jackfish, while dinner attracts lionfish, reef sharks, moray eels and sting rays.
facts.excerpt: During the day, SEA showcases turtles, butterflyfish, unicorn fish and jackfish in their natural habitat, whilst dinner time attracts nocturnal predators including lionfish, reef sharks, moray eels and sting rays.

facts.text: At the overwater spa, marine life glides beneath the treatment bed.
facts.excerpt: as marine life glides beneath your treatment bed

facts.text: The overwater spa has floor-to-ceiling glass windows and offers therapies rooted in Ayurvedic tradition, sound healing and energy healing.
facts.excerpt: overwater spa with floor-to-ceiling glass windows, with a strong focus on wellness including therapies rooted in Ayurvedic tradition, sound healing and energy healing

facts.text: Villas sit on sandy shores or over the water, each with its own pool and a swinging daybed.
facts.excerpt: steps from the ocean on sandy shores or directly perched over azure waters. Swim in your pool. Laze on a swinging daybed.

facts.text: Villas come with Villa Host service.
facts.excerpt: Villa Host service

facts.text: Villa bathtubs either have glass bottoms or are surrounded by reflection ponds.
facts.excerpt: fantasy bathtubs, either with glass bottoms or surrounded by reflection ponds

facts.text: Residences have two to four bedrooms, each with an ensuite.
facts.excerpt: Two to four bedrooms each with ensuite

facts.text: Snorkeling equipment, life jackets and kayaks are complimentary.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary usage of snorkeling equipment, life jackets and kayaks

facts.text: The Thiththi Boli Kids' Club offers activities for children aged 4 to 12.
facts.excerpt: Our Thiththi Boli Kid's club offers exciting and packed activities for children aged 4 to 12 years old.

facts.text: The resort is a 35-minute seaplane journey from Male International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Anantara Kihavah is located a 35 minute seaplane journey from Male International Airport.

facts.text: Seaplane journeys to the resort run during daytime hours only; guests arriving in the Maldives after 3:30 pm can be booked on domestic flights.
facts.excerpt: Seaplane journeys to Anantara Kihavah are available during daytime hours only. For guests arriving in the Maldives after 3:30 pm, we are pleased to arrange domestic flights.

facts.text: Unauthorised drones are prohibited on the resort premises, and there is a professional photography and videography studio on site.
facts.excerpt: we have a professional photography and videography studio on site

facts.text: The resort has a dive centre, a padel court, a tennis court and a water sports centre.

facts.text: The resort offers underwater wine tasting.
facts.excerpt: Underwater Wine Tasting
